dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Make the regression test assert that the NESTED probe run (cwd=REPO_ROOT, PYTHONPATH=site) actually imported rebar from the relocated copy, not just the separate cwd=tmp_path liveness subprocess.
evidence: tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py:227 — located subprocess runs with cwd=tmp_path and asserts origin.is_relative_to(site)
tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py:239-248 — the nested pytest that runs the probe is launched with cwd=REPO_ROOT, a different working directory from the liveness check

tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py:161 — the nested probe takes its anchor from the imported rebar (reconciler_src = Path(rebar.__file__).parent/'reconciler'), so an in-nested import resolving to src/ still passes with src-vs-src and the probe would not detect that the copy was bypassed

ABSENCE: no assertion inside/after the nested run confirms rebar resolved to the copy (e.g. no grep of the nested output for the site path, no probe that prints rebar.__file__ in the same cwd=REPO_ROOT invocation)
dropped.finding: The new regression test never asserts that the NESTED pytest run (which actually executes the probe) imports rebar from the relocated copy. The only proof the copy is used comes from a separate subprocess run with cwd=tmp_path, while the nested probe runs with cwd=REPO_ROOT; the probe derives its anchor from whatever rebar it imports, so if the nested run resolved rebar from the editable src/ tree instead of the PYTHONPATH copy, the probe would still pass with 'src vs src' and the relocation regression would go undetected.
scenarios: An editable-install environment where a REPO_ROOT conftest or .pth ordering causes the nested run to import rebar from src/ despite PYTHONPATH=site; the probe passes vacuously and the regression test gives false assurance.
dropped.suggested_fix: In the same nested invocation (cwd=REPO_ROOT, env with PYTHONPATH=site), assert the imported rebar resolves under site — e.g. add a tiny probe that prints rebar.__file__ and assert the printed path is relative to site, or pass cwd=tmp_path to the nested run to match the liveness check's resolution conditions.
